erasure.reason: Operational deletion receipt; no Auth/profile FK. Content/account deletion cannot erase evidence or reopen unresolved execution.
erasure.terminalPurge: Only completed/failed/abandoned after receipt_expires_at, by service-only purge_terminal_requests. No scheduler installed.
erasure.unresolved: No time-based purge or failure. Execution reconciliation is required.
erasure.legalStatus: 365-day product value approved; legal basis and 30-day negative receipt retention remain activation gates.

export.reason: Private operational ledger, outside public account-export graph. Capability-authenticated receipt lookup exposes the minimal status projection. Session IDs and capability digests must not enter a general export.
export.activationGate: Review the retained owner association and user access route before numbering/activation; public inventory passing alone is not evidence for this private table.

owner_id.reason: Account lock and request binding; never public receipt output.

session_id.reason: Exact admission session binding, never public output.

request_id.reason: Retained idempotency binding prevents request reuse.

lookup_hash.reason: Lookup digest; never export capability material.

recovery_hash.reason: Separate recovery digest; never export capability material.

execution_id.reason: Exclusive execution generation; no automatic takeover.

observations.reason: Four bounded status values; no paths, error bodies or counts.
